{{Quote|This is obviously an act of terrorism. What did the Republic do to stop this? Where are our Jedi? That's it for Tynna. I'll be contacting Count Dooku once we can establish new government headquarters somewhere.|Razelfiin|<ref name="YeNews" />}}
The '''Tynnan government''' was the planetary government of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]]. Having reinvested profits from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] commercial ventures into society, the [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] government's spending produced a wealthy state-run economy that provided basic amenities for its citizens.

Originally based at the [[Tynna Central Government Building]], the government was forced to relocate following a [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mite]] infestation shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and its leader [[Razelfiin]] declared Tynna's secession from the Republic to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] amid the resultant political fallout. After the loss of the Tynna Central Government Building, the Tynnan government was later based at the [[Tanallay Surge complex]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Tynnan government was intimidated by Imperial forces, which later staged an [[Invasion of Tynna|invasion]] of Tynna; however, the attack was foiled by an impenetrable [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]].

==Description==
[[File:Tynna.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Tynnan government governed Tynna (pictured).]]
The [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] government was a planetary government that ran the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]].<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo" /> With the development of Tynna's economy fueled by [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] conglomerates through its [[Refinery/Legends|refineries]] and processing plants, the Tynnan government reinvested the resultant profits into local society. As such, the Tynnan populace was one of the wealthiest in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] on a [[Species/Legends|being]]-for-being basis, and basic amenities including [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], housing, education, and entertainment were provided free of charge by the state.<ref name="HanSoCorSecSource">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> Matters concerning the government included community meetings and [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] platform control legislation,<ref name="HerdHeist">{{JournalCite|15|The Great Herdship Heist}}</ref> as well as research.<ref name="YeNews" />

Positions in the Tynnan government,<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo" /> which included planetary leader, General Council Assistant,<ref name="YeNews" /> and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]],<ref name="WhoWhoTT">{{InsiderCite|85|Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000}}</ref> were selected by lottery; as such, Tynnans kept themselves informed of outstanding developments.<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo" />  Selected individuals served in a governing legislature; they were expected to serve a term of one [[Standard year/Legends|year]], after which they could not do so again for another six years. All Tynnans were considered equal before the law and were instructed to take responsibility for their actions.<ref name="HanSoCorSecSource" /> Those selected were obligated to fulfill their given role; if the individual did not so desire, their only alternative was to flee Tynna.<ref name="HerdHeist" />

==History==
{{Quote|I looked up from my research and found myself looking at Lutris Lake, and I don't have a window. My whole wall was gone by the time I could tell anyone.|Zobyteeg|<ref name="YeNews" />}}
[[File:Tanallay_Surge_complex.png|thumb|left|300px|The Tynnan government was eventually based at the Tanallay Surge Complex (pictured).]]
Shortly before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|onset]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="CSWE Razelfiin">{{CSWECite|III|84|Razelfiin}}</ref> fought between the Galactic Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the Tynnan government was based at the [[Tynna Central Government Building]] in [[Lutris]]. In that year, the government was forced to find other premises after a [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mite]] infestation destroyed the building. In the aftermath of the destruction, planetary leader [[Razelfiin]] declared that she would contact<ref name="YeNews" /> Separatist [[Head of State/Legends|leader]]<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] owing to a lack of Republic or [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] support in the matter.<ref name="YeNews" /> However, Tynna ultimately remained a Republic member state during the Clone Wars proper<ref name="TEA" /> and was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by Senator [[Streamdrinker/Legends|Streamdrinker]]<ref name="Newz">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref> as of [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="StreamdrinkerArrest">"[[Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241]]" states that [[Streamdrinker/Legends|Streamdrinker]] held the position of [[Senator/Legends|senator]] when he was [[Senatorial arrests/Legends|arrested]] shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref>

The Tynnan government was later based at the [[Tanallay Surge complex]].<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo" /> During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the local Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] attempted to cow the Tynnan legislature into increasing resource output;<ref name="HanSoCorSecSource" /> in spite of the Tynnans' attempts to placate the governor's demands, the Empire subsequently launched a full-scale [[Invasion of Tynna|invasion]]. The attack was repelled by an impenetrable [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]], and the Empire was forced to abandon the incursion.<ref name="EssGuiAliSpec">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>

==Members==
Prominent members of the Tynnan government included Razelfiin, who had been elected to the position of planetary leader<ref name="YeNews" /> as of 22 BBY.<ref name="RazelfiinWhen">[[Razelfiin]]'s entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' states that she was planetary leader shortly before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|onset]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> The position of General Council Assistant was occupied by [[Zobyteeg]] in the same year.<ref name="YeNews" /> As of 19 BBY,<ref name="StreamdrinkerArrest" /> Tynna was represented by Senator Streamdrinker in the Galactic Senate.<ref name="Newz" /> Roughly four years prior<ref name="HerdHeist" /> to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="EssReaComp">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> explosives maven [[Dawson (Tynnan)|Dawson]] was selected by lottery for a position involving community meetings and orbital platform control legislation; unwilling to fulfill that role, Dawson left Tynna, never to return.<ref name="HerdHeist" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tynnan government was first mentioned in the [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]'', which was written by [[Michael Allen Horne]] and released in [[1993]] by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="HanSoCorSecSource" />
